criticalFindings: Visible case IDs, evidence IDs and source IDs contain TRAIN, DEV, HOLDOUT or REPLICATION and the case ordinal.
Every generated entity pair follows materialNumber = revisionNumber + 900.
A missing material can be reconstructed from the revision token and a missing revision can be reconstructed from the material token.
The evidence alias mapping is not opaque enough because canonical and visible identifiers encode case structure.
The generic case CLI contains a syntax error in its invalid-request fallback; the happy-path dispatch still ran, so generation and validation did not expose it.

interpretation: Candidate v2 correctly tests 48 distinct propositions with balanced case-local evidence, but visible identifiers and deterministic entity pairing provide avoidable shortcuts. It is retained as design evidence and must not be frozen or shown to Qwen.
